title: Amberwell retail — reorder edge playbook (jot)
content:
Quick working notes from onboarding call with Amberwell (11/03) — capture of requirements, gotchas, early design heuristics and next steps. Informal — use for internal sync and later clean-up into proper runbook.

Attendees: Tom Hargreaves (Amberwell CTO), Lina Park (product), Rajiv Menon (store ops lead), Priya D. (me), Miles B. (SE), Sofia A. (infra).

Problem / ask:
- Amberwell wants an in-store reorder assistant integrated with POS & shelf sensors. Goal: reduce out-of-stock incidents and speed restock ordering.
- Target interaction: cashier/stock associate speaks or types quick phrase ("reorder tomatoes"), assistant returns top SKU match, quantity suggestion, and a suggested reorder reason/category.
- Must run with private deployment on local edge boxes (per-store devices) and fall back to cloud when connectivity is available.

Constraints called out on call:
- Intermittent network (store WAN can drop for minutes). Need local inference for basic flows.
- Edge boxes are NUC-class with a small GPU (e.g., RTX A2000 or no-GPU fallback). Worst-case: CPU-only for <1k tokens; plan for quantized models.
- PII: transaction IDs and cashier IDs must never leave the customer VPC. They will provide a VPC with restricted egress and a customer KMS.
- Latency SLO: interactive UI target <200ms median for single-turn SKU lookup; 95th percentile <450ms.
- Throughput: expected peak bursts of ~150 req/s per store during morning rush; typical sustained <30 req/s.
- Footprint: local disk budget ~60GB for model+cache; prefer smaller models (7B quantized) with fallback to larger model in dedicated region.
- Observability: need per-request cost/latency breakdown and local logging that ships to Amberwell's SIEM when connectivity returns.

Important gotchas / red flags:
- POS integration: their POS will send product shortcodes that are ambiguous across regions. Must include region context from store metadata; otherwise fuzzy-match rate spikes.
- Shelf sensor TTL: sensor microservice can delay stock events by up to 90s. If we naively use sensor events for reorder triggers we'll double-order. Need debounce logic and recent-reads window.
- Key rotation: their KMS auto-rotates keys monthly; local agent must be able to pull new wrapped keys without manual intervention. Test rotation flow during staging.
- Network fallback behavior: cache-only mode must explicitly return a "stale-data" banner in UI; Amberwell legal wants disclaimers for orders made during offline mode.

Initial technical approach (sketch):
- Edge Agent: lightweight container with Redwood runtime trimmed to model family + tokenizer + prefix/KV cache. Runtime config: CPU-first codepath + optional ONNX/FP16/INT8 kernels based on available hardware.
- Model profile: recommend starting with a 7B LLaMA-family fine-tuned SKU-matching head quantized to 4-bit (q4f16/q4_0). Evaluate latency on A2000 and Skylake CPU; provide measured numbers.
- Caching: local prefix cache for recent SKUs and pricelist. Persistent small LRU for 10k entries (~20MB). KV cache warmup from nightly delta sync.
- Batching: adaptive micro-batching by 10–25ms windows during rush to hit throughput without blowing tail latencies.
- Routing: local runtime primary; when store detects healthy WAN and low latency to regional cloud, enable hybrid routing for complex queries to 13B variant in dedicated capacity.
- Privacy: scrub transaction IDs before logs leave host; only hashed IDs allowed. Implement 'scrub-level' config.

Testing matrix to run in PoC:
- Perf: cold-start latency, steady-state median, p95 for sample workloads (typing + voice tokenized).
- Faults: WAN drop simulation, KMS rotation simulation, POS malformed shortcode cases.
- Quality: confusion matrix on SKU matches (precision@1, top3 recall) over 2k anonymized SKU matching pairs Amberwell will provide.
- Cost sims: tokens per session, average (and extreme) batch sizes; projected per-store monthly inference cost with local-only vs hybrid.

Immediate action items (owners + rough ETA):
- Collect SKU sample and region mapping dump (Amberwell) — Rajiv / Lina — due 2025-11-07.
- SE perf baseline: run 7B q4 inference on A2000 + 8-core CPU; return latencies and memory numbers — Miles — due 2025-11-10.
- Edge packaging sketch (docker-compose + systemd agent) and quickstart script for their IT to install on NUCs — Sofia — due 2025-11-14.
- Security review checklist for KMS integration and key wrapping — Priya — due 2025-11-12 (draft).
- Create PoC Confluence page and link notes + validation criteria — Priya/Miles — due 2025-11-05.

Notes for follow-up call (aim schedule second week of Nov):
- Bring sample latency screenshots from our bench and discuss model tradeoffs (7B local vs 13B regional).
- Walk through offline UX: what store clerk sees when WAN drops and when we fallback to cached suggestions. Need design sign-off.
- Confirm legal wording for "stale-data" banner and log handling.
- Demo KMS rotation flow with their security engineer present (they requested live handshake).

Loose prompts / heuristics to iterate for SKUs (these are quick prompt sketches for later eval):
- "User: reorder [item phrase]; Context: store_id=____; last_stock_read=2025-10-31T09:14Z; recent_sales_last_24h=5\nSystem: Return: {sku_id, match_score(0-1), suggested_qty, reason_short}"
- Use explicit region tokens: avoid global name matching first-pass; require region index affinity >0.6.
- If match_score<0.4 => return search-suggestion flow (ask for clarification).

Misc smaller notes / personal reminders:
- Need to confirm whether Amberwell wants model artifacts signed + checksums in install bundle.
- Ask infra if we can reduce default cache persistence TTL to 48h for compliance.
- Confirm data retention window for local logs (they mentioned 90 days, but legal might push for 30).

Next immediate steps (this doc will be the working source until we move to the Confluence PoC page):
- Send this rough recap to Amberwell (Tom & Lina) with action items and proposed PoC schedule. Mention we'll try baseline perf within 3 business days.
- Create PoC env repo scaffold and attach sample bench scripts (will link to PR).

-- end jot --

Brain-dump tags for later search: amberwell, reorder, edge-agent, kiosk, private-kms, offline-ux, sku-matching, q4-quant, latency-slo
